## Quintet

**Five columns** of icons on your Home Screen pages instead of four, and room for **five icons in the Dock**.

- Works on pages with widgets too: widgets are resized so they fit the grid.
- Folders, the Today View and the App Library stay as they are.
- **One setting:** Settings → Quintet → **Five-Icon Dock**, on by default. Turn it off if another tweak changes your Dock. Uninstall and your icons flow back to four columns.

screenshots.accessibilityText: A Home Screen with five columns of icons and widgets

views.markdown:
- **New setting:** the five-icon Dock can be turned off (Settings → Quintet), for people who use another Dock tweak. A fifth Dock icon then moves to the Home Screen. Home Screen pages always get five columns. There's a Respring button.
- **iOS 17 and A12 and newer confirmed** (iPhone SE 2nd gen, iOS 17.5.1).

- **arm64 and arm64e** (A12 and newer) builds, made with Xcode's toolchain and checked for the correct arm64e format.
- Tested on an **iPhone 7 (A10)** with iOS 15.8.6 and Dopamine. Also tested on an **iPhone SE (2nd gen, A13)** with iOS 17.5.1 (arm64e), so **A12 and newer are confirmed**. iOS 16 isn't confirmed yet: please [report back](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues). If it puts you into safe mode, open Sileo (safe mode still allows it) and uninstall it.

- **Beta.** If something looks wrong, uninstall it and please [report back](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).
- iOS moves icons around by itself when the grid changes; nothing is lost.
- Only for rootless jailbreaks with ElleKit (Dopamine).
Written from scratch by **John d_ie**, after a request on r/jailbreak.
